text: Requested by Sri (the owner). When a reading puts work out of scope as follow-up requests, queue each named follow-up as its own request, citing the original job, instead of leaving it as text in the reading record. Today nothing turns out_of_scope follow-ups into requests, so the work is lost: job 20261114-034034-fgwz read Sri's request as one Hestia change and listed the rest (queue order, holding the October backlog, review findings) as follow-ups that were never queued.
